items.name: Naschgarten Erdbeeren
items.description: Coral-red tub heaped with plump strawberries with green calyxes and yellow seeds, a cream label band with one big strawberry. Generic German tub of strawberries, brand Naschgarten.

items.name: Zesprit Kiwi
items.label: ZESPRIT
items.description: Parody of the Zespri kiwi: one whole brown fuzzy kiwi with a white oval sticker saying ZESPRIT and a cut half in front showing bright green flesh, cream core and a ring of dark seeds. Natural proportions, no stretching.

items.name: Rebenglück Blaue Trauben
items.description: Natural tapering bunch of thirteen blue-violet grapes hanging from a brown stem with one green vine leaf. Generic German supermarket blue grapes, product Blaue Trauben.

items.name: Sauerlustig Zitronen
items.description: Lime-green net bag with a crimped yellow seal, four bright yellow lemons inside and a cream label with a lemon. German brand Sauerlustig, product Zitronen.
